body: Five AI-related interviews plus one explicitly non-AI comparator supply 24 account/episode envelopes and 41 selected incidents. Many envelopes are generalized accounts, not independent events. All empirical incidents are mediated speaker reports, interpretations or a company claim, not direct observations. Unknown outcomes remain unknown.

The same experienced user reports browser success and failure; a newer colleague reportedly delegates diagnosis faster than an expert using familiar tools; non-AI accounts contain testing and broad initiative. The comparisons rule out an automatic equation of skill, more manual action, or more options with greater agency. They do not isolate causal effects because tasks, roles and technologies differ.

Do not turn a prepared demo into novice effectiveness, a Cowork retry narrative into OpenClaw evidence, meal-planning advice into an observed recovery, a ten-day release push into total effort, or a produced rubric into valid hiring decisions. Opening trailers duplicate later accounts. Initial source-near proposals were generated in parallel; root revised CDE204 through CDE216 because the user asked to find a leak, not specifically to build a diagnostic tool. Category versions formalize a within-pilot reasoning progression, not separate sampling waves.

Initial subset reading: lower manual implementation can coexist with human planning and review. This motivates separating execution share from direction. It is not yet a general theory or permanent division of capacities.

supersession_reason: AI-produced criteria, reciprocal tasking, goal revision and non-AI comparisons require a more relational and conditional account.
body: Candidate theoretical framing: human agency through revisable delegation. Define action reach as what a person can attempt or accomplish; distinguish it from practical revision capacity over goals, means, standards and commitments. AI can widen the first while leaving the second unchanged or compromised. Proposed process: an opportunity or difficulty prompts delegation; people encounter outputs and limits; they inspect, accept, renegotiate, reclaim or reframe work; the arrangement and feasible goals may change. This is an assembled process hypothesis, not an observed universal sequence. Criteria and goals may also emerge through AI interaction. Meaningful revision requires more than formal accountability, but its knowledge, infrastructure and organizational conditions are unresolved.

Commercially interested, successful technology insiders dominate this purposive archive sample. The host is an Every investor. No direct worker refusal, long-term deskilling, displaced worker, stable failed adopter or independently observed AI-recommendation disagreement is available in this pilot. Literature novelty, primary media accuracy, exact episode dates and model deployment identifier are unverified. Tool validation cannot create authority or truth. All output NON_RELEASE; stopping status NOT_REACHED.

C002 adds eight interviews, 27 account envelopes and 78 incidents. The accounts include explicit support-product shutdown, shelving/restart, external-provider unblocking and an unreleased demo. They are reported actions and interpretations, not independently observed trajectories. All 344 files were lexically screened, not all coded.

The main divergence is between requesting another correction and obtaining a change that makes work viable. Similar trouble receives local patches, model-to-model critique, specialist transfer, provider escalation, waiting for capability, restriction or shutdown. These are alternative pathways, not a universal progression. Novice success survives as a thin countercase; expert failure prevents an expertise-only account.

The crash removed the external runtime, not saved proposals. C001 was mechanically reconstructed with identical rows and explicit replay provenance; C002 continues that new seal. Historical original C001 stays unchanged. Source fidelity checked against exact spans. Founder/manager accounts, commercial selection, shared organizational ties and hypothetical workers limit inference. OUTCOME_OBSERVED means a reported endpoint is explicit, not direct analyst observation. Private Git snapshot is the documented Operator override of the skill default. No saturation or release.

Revise the pilot proposal: agency through revisable delegation requires investigating whether revisions can be made consequential, not simply whether a review channel exists. Candidate process: delegate and encounter an output; judge adequacy using revisable criteria; attempt local correction; where inadequate, seek a change in expertise, infrastructure or scope, restrict use, or withdraw. Success can itself broaden the task and reopen this sequence. Resource access and authority are candidate conditions measured independently of success. CAT003 remains thin and is not enlarged merely by more task-level criteria examples. Next compare specialist reframing, provider-level evaluation repair and actual organizational authority, seeking minimally supported success and resource-rich failure as rivals. This is a conditional proposition, not a causal finding.

C003 adds eight interviews and35 current account envelopes with115 incidents. The retained records include rewrites without demonstrated durable recovery, an acceptable email sent without expected approval, an unresolved privacy-performance conflict, changed provider evaluation, organizational allocation rules and a broad turnaround. All are interview-mediated; several outcomes are narrow intermediate endpoints.

Comparisons distinguish acceptable output from authorized procedure; local repair from reframing and external change; initial access from sustained operation; voluntary help and refusal from imposed commitments; and AI-related explanations from reorganization and conventional hierarchy. Autonomous task recovery, terse everyday prompting, favorable unapproved content, senior refusal and public leadership challenge remain countercases. They prevent universal human-checkpoint, expertise, overload or silencing claims.

Independent audit prompted E714 to retain both the expected approval procedure and narrow content acceptance, and MEM014 to replace broad novice-success language with situated noncoder claims. E713 clarifies the intended recruitment goal without inventing a hire. Same-creator/organization ties, vendor accounts, survey mediation and survivor selection limit inference. Amol personal medical segment is excluded as irrelevant; Sander health assertions are not analytical evidence. No primary-media, causal, prevalence, novelty or saturation claim. Staffing-independent agent review is same-model, unblinded and not human methodological judgment.

supersession_reason: Second-wave countercases require separating result, authorization and commitments, and specifying organizational consequences and rival explanations.
body: The candidate explanation is agency through consequential revision: people may expand what they can attempt while remaining differently able to authorize means, revise criteria, obtain repair or limit resulting commitments. This is a research proposition, not a definition from which effects are deduced. A disagreement or discrepancy can lead to local correction, autonomous route change, specialist reframing, infrastructure intervention, narrowing, pause or withdrawal. Paths need not converge on success. Resources and authority must be measured before outcomes, not inferred from success. Capacity can generate additional obligations for other people. Organizational structure, task complexity, voluntary engagement and retrospective rationalization remain live rivals. Noncoder successes do not establish no expertise; favorable output does not prove control. Direct worker trajectories and durable comparative outcomes remain missing.
